reason: The user-provided value flows through doSomething and is only used in a conditional assignment where it is discarded if the guard condition fails. The guard condition (7*42 - num > 200) evaluates to false (since 7*42=294, 294-106=188 which is not greater than 200), so bar is set to "This should never happen" rather than the user input. Thus, the user input never reaches the HTML output sink.
